meetings.title: 7th Meeting 2026
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, members met with the officials from the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Skills Development and the Maldives Qualification Authority (MQA) to discuss the issue raised regarding the lack of a robust system to ensure the quality of online higher education programs in the Maldives. meetings.title: 4th Meeting 2026
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, members met with the officials of Ministry of Health, Family and Welfare regarding the issue, raising concern about failure of the ministry to formulate regulations under the Act number 6/2024 (Food Safety Act). According to the ministry, after merging some of the regulations a total of 14 regulations need to be formulated under the Act, out of which 2 have been published in government gazette. They also stated that except 4 regulations all others are currently in the gazette stage and that work on the remaining regulations is expected to be completed by August 2026. They also reported that the drafting of regulations was delayed due to insufficient budget, and that the regulations are currently being formulated by consultants funded by Asian Development Bank (ADB).

Manadhoo constituency Member Husnee Mubarik proposed meeting with the relevant officials of the Ministry of Health to clarify the matter. Hence, the committee voted unanimously to remove 3 regulations listed in Annex 1 of and to extend the period for implementation of the regulation listed in Annex 2 of Act no 6/2008 (General Regulations Act) until 30 April 2027. meetings.title: 9th Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: During today's meeting, members discussed the pending issues in the committee status. Firstly, the committee decided to file 2 issues submitted regarding the regulations formulated by Maldives Inland Revenue Authority by a whistleblower, as a decision has been made regarding this issue previously. Secondly, the committee discussed the issue of reviewing the regulations under the Ministry of Education and Ministry of Higher education, Labour and Skills Development. As the contradictions identified in some of the regulations have been discussed with the officials of the ministries it was decided to file this issue unanimously. Then members discussed the letter sent to get statistics of regulations not framed under the acts passed by People’s Majlis and decided to share the information received by the relevant ministries to the member who proposed the issue. Furthermore, the committee discussed the issue submitted to review the policy established by the Ministry of Education, regarding Persons who can attend school functions as guests of honor. As the ministry has informed that members of parliament are included in the lists of people who can be the Guest of Honor in school functions, it was decided to file the issue. Lastly, members discussed the issue submitted to review safety measures for tourists and the issue proposed to find ways to ensure tourists safety when tourists staying in resorts use the excursion services offered by guesthouses in nearby residential islands. The committee has met with the officials from the Ministry of Tourism and Environment regarding these issues and have been informed that measures are being taken to ensure safety of tourists through amendments to relevant regulations, so it was decided to file these 2 issues. Details of votes taken in this meeting are on “Votes” section of this page.
